visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young women stand close together in a medium shot. The woman in the center wears a light pink silk qipao with floral patterns. The woman on the left wears a black qipao with gold embroidery and red lipstick. The woman on the right wears a vibrant red qipao with gold floral patterns and her hair in a bun. They perform synchronized, stylized hand gestures including pointing, circling hands, and rhythmic shoulder movements while maintaining direct eye contact with the camera. Behind them, a white-walled studio environment is visible, featuring a large black professional studio softbox light mounted on a stand. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the silk dresses. (2) The rhythmic posing concludes as the women break their formal stances. The woman in the center leans slightly forward with a broad smile, her long dark hair falling over her shoulders. The woman on the right leans towards the center, laughing and speaking animatedly. The background remains the same studio setting with neutral tones and bright lighting. No significant camera movement occurs during this shift from performance to candid interaction.
